cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard shadows, pastel field. A cramped equipment storeroom seen straight on: steel shelving stacked with coiled cable, dive harnesses, numbered crates, a clipboard hanging on a nail. One bare bulb, warm. Kou stands against the shelves on the left in his uniform, clipboard still in one hand, sleeve pushed back off the bandaged forearm, expression completely flat — solid black hair as the darkest mass on the page. Kanade stands opposite him, back pressed to the closed door, gloved hands flat against it behind her, hair up in the precise twist, gold pin straight, and her public smile entirely gone from her face for the first time in the series. Neither is looking at the other's eyes. Under the door, a hard band of corridor light, and in it: the shadows of feet, several people, walking past. The room is about a metre and a half wide.

panels.action: Day one of four.

dialogue.text: Four desks away. Second row. Blank pin.
Bandage on the left forearm, and under it, two loops.
I have looked at that boy every day for two years.
I have never once seen him.

chars.name: kanade

chars.pose: seated, textbook open, pen not moving

chars.name: riko

chars.pose: standing beside her desk with a tablet

panels.bg: classroom, students packing up, afternoon light, tone wash
panels.action: Mizusawa Riko has been reading her for three years and is not slow.

dialogue.text: You've been on that page nine minutes.
It's a dense page.
It's the contents page.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sweating, eyes swirling, smile rictus-tight
chars.pose: chibi, gripping the textbook with both hands

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, arms folded, entirely still

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background

You're staring at Hazama.
WHO.
You know who. He sits four desks away.

chars.expression: mild, packing his bag, entirely unaware
chars.pose: four desks away, cloth bundle going under one arm

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: cheerful, in passing

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: smile gone, watching that happen with completely new eyes
chars.pose: seated, hand flat on the contents page

panels.bg: classroom, blurred students, hard flat tone closing in at the frame edges

He put his arm under a falling pillar so I'd still have a head.
And here he says 'yeah, fair' about the chairs.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: determined, striding, jaw set

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, at his locker

dialogue.text: Right. Say it. Say the words in the correct order.
'Hazama-kun, I believe we have met.' Fine. Good. Normal.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: public smile deployed at maximum, eyes dead with panic

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: turning, mild

panels.bg: corridor, lockers, morning light
panels.action: Attempt one, outcome.

dialogue.text: Morning, Hazama-kun.
Morning.
Sentence eleven. SENTENCE ELEVEN.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: >_<, chibi, tearing a note into confetti with her teeth

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, watching from one seat over

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Attempt two. Wednesday. A written note, drafted eleven times, destroyed.

dialogue.text: It sounded like a hostage demand!
What did it say.
'I KNOW WHAT YOU DID ON THURSDAY.'
Yes. Burn that.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, mouth open mid-word

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: arriving with an armful of forms, oblivious

panels.bg: classroom, Wednesday afternoon, tone wash
panels.action: Attempt three. Interrupted at the syllable.

dialogue.text: Hazama-kun, could I—
Ariake-san! The committee needs your signature, sorry, sorry—
Of course. Happy to.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: signing something, smiling beautifully, entirely elsewhere

panels.bg: the form, the pen, blurred committee students, hard flat tone
panels.action: Three days. Nine attempts. Zero sentences.

dialogue.text: I can address four hundred people about gate discipline.
I can level a room on layer thirty-two.
I cannot walk four desks and say one true thing.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: cross-legged on her bed with the tablet, not looking up

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: face-down on her own bed, still in uniform

panels.bg: a small dormitory room — two beds, two desks, one window, the Tower visible outside, tone-washed
panels.action: Wednesday, 10pm. Roommates for three years.

dialogue.text: You've been carrying something since Monday.
I've been carrying committee forms.
You said that in the same voice as 'I wasn't diving'.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: one eye visible, testing something
chars.pose: face still half in the pillow

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: tablet down, listening properly

panels.bg: dorm room, lamp, night window, tone wash
panels.action: She goes at it sideways because she cannot go at it directly.

dialogue.text: Riko. If you found out somebody wasn't who you thought—
Is this about the ban.
It isn't about the ban.
Then it's worse than the ban.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: flat, professional, three years of practice

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: listening

panels.bg: dorm, lamp light, tone wash
panels.action: This is what Riko actually is: the only person who tells her the truth on schedule.

dialogue.text: Gate logs, forged. Faculty ban, ignored. Forty-one dives.
I've covered all of it because you'd die without it.
So whatever this is, say it out loud or stop bleeding on me.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the sincerity arriving and being unbearable
chars.pose: sitting up, hair down for once, out of the twist

panels.bg: dorm, lamp, flat tone
panels.action: Her hair is down. It is the tower silhouette, in a bedroom, and she does not notice.

dialogue.text: There's someone I've known for thirteen months.
I found out he's been four desks away the whole time.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: chibi, glasses flashing white, entire face going flat with horror

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, hands up, backpedalling

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. Riko has done the arithmetic instantly and hated every step of it.

dialogue.text: Four desks. Blank pin. Bandage. Never talks.
Kanade. Is your front-line partner HAZAMA?
I'm going to sleep now. Goodnight. Good night forever.

panels.bg: the dive hall at 9:50pm Thursday — rows of couches under a ceiling of cabling, the handle board glowing on the far wall, technicians in the aisles, tone-washed
panels.action: Thursday. Same time Thursday.

dialogue.text: Front line, hall two. Gate opens twenty-two hundred.
Thirteen months, we've done this.
Fifty-eight dives. She's never once been late.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: sprawled, straw in his mouth, one eye covered

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, testing the wrap on his forearm

panels.bg: couches, cabling, the handle board behind them
panels.action: PIKE has been on the front line four years and misses nothing.

dialogue.text: Arm any good?
It works.
That's not the same answer as 'good', Null.
It's the one I've got.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: nodding at the handle board, cheerful about something grim

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: looking up at it

panels.bg: the handle board — a grid of names and layer numbers, NULL and KETTLE at the top with 32 beside them
panels.action: Two handles, one number, and every diver in the building can read it.

dialogue.text: Thirty-two. Whole building's been looking at that all week.
Two of you. No party. No healer. Nothing.
She's very loud. It covers a lot of gaps.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: rumpled, folder out, not looking at him

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: lying back, cabling at the temple

panels.bg: the aisle, strip lighting, technicians
panels.action: The institution does its bit.

dialogue.text: Handle and pin.
Null. Pin's blank, sir.
One of these days somebody's going to audit me.
Then I'd stop, sir.
...No, you wouldn't. Gate's twenty-two hundred.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes closing as the dive takes
chars.pose: flat, cabling at the temple, light going white at the frame edges

panels.bg: the couch from above, the cable ceiling, white bleed at the panel edges
panels.action: Ten seconds.

dialogue.text: Whatever's wrong with the ground floor, it doesn't come up with me.
That's the deal. Ten seconds and I'm somebody.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: hood up, scanning, sword sheathed
chars.pose: tower figure, on a narrow bridge of pale stone

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hair down, coat, bare hands, staring at him instead of the room
chars.pose: tower figure, two paces behind, not moving

panels.bg: Layer 33 — a lattice of thin stone bridges over nothing, drifting motes, black below and above, tone-washed with hard perspective
panels.action: Layer thirty-three. She has known for four days and he has known for none.

dialogue.text: Bridges. No cover. Don't cast wide or you'll drop us both.
Mm.
...You said 'mm'. You've never said 'mm' in your life.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sweating, halo of panic lines, smile too wide

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, deeply suspicious

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch, on a bridge, over nothing.

dialogue.text: I'm normal! I'm having a normal one!
You called me an idiot four times last week.
You haven't done it once tonight.
IDIOT. There. Fixed.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, walking behind him, staring at the back of his head

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: ahead, scanning the bridges

panels.bg: the stone lattice, motes, black void
panels.action: She has questions. All of them are unaskable and she asks them anyway.

dialogue.text: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
...We are mid-corridor on layer thirty-three.
It's a normal question!
One. Older.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: stopping, half-turning, genuinely confused now
chars.pose: hand going up to halt her

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: innocent, catastrophically transparent

panels.bg: narrow bridge, black below, motes
panels.action: It gets worse before it gets better.

dialogue.text: Do you like curry?
Kettle.
It's a preference! People have them!
Are you concussed? Did something hit you on the way in?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: gone flat, sword clearing
chars.pose: already turning toward the far end of the bridge

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hands coming up, professional in half a second

panels.bg: the stone lattice, and along four bridges at once, pale shapes running — fast ones, low, tone-washed and half-drawn
panels.action: The argument ends the way it always ends.

dialogue.text: Nine. From four directions. They're fast on stone.
Bridge or drop?
Bridge. Drop the two behind us, hold the middle.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: teeth bared, both palms down on the stone
chars.pose: on one knee, the bridge behind them detonating

panels.bg: the lattice, two bridges coming apart in a bloom of white, shapes falling into black, radial focus lines
panels.action: Two bridges. She does not miss.

dialogue.text: Two down! Behind's clear!
Good. Don't watch them fall, watch the middle—
I know! I've done this fifty-eight times!
Fifty-nine.
NOT NOW.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes fully open, absolutely still in the middle of it
chars.pose: one lateral cut, two shapes coming apart, a third already on him

panels.bg: the narrow bridge, black below, dust and motes, tone wash
panels.action: No magic. No shield. Footwork and a stick and knowing where everything is.

dialogue.text: Four. Five.
Six. They're going for the spans, not for us.
Kettle, the left one's going — get across before it—

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: running flat out, hair everywhere, entirely trusting

panels.bg: the span breaking behind her heels, black below, hard motion lines
panels.action: She does not look down and she does not check. She has not checked for eight months.

dialogue.text: It's going, it's going—
CATCH!
Got you. I've always got you. Jump.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: gripping his forearm, and looking at the bandage under her own hand
chars.pose: hauled up onto the near span, half over the edge

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: pulling, hood shadow across the eyes

panels.bg: the stone lip, black below, close, tone wash
panels.action: Her hand is on the wrap. Under it, two loops.

dialogue.text: Nine.
Nine. Layer's clear.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting on the stone getting her breath, not letting go of his arm yet

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: crouched, checking the far bridges

panels.bg: the cleared lattice, drifting motes, black in every direction
panels.action: Thirty-three. Nobody has ever stood here either.

dialogue.text: Thirty-three.
Thirty-three.
Say something.
You're still holding my arm.
That's not — that's an OBSERVATION—

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: hood back, sitting on the stone, entirely at ease
chars.pose: sword across his knees, wiping it down

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: watching him do it

panels.bg: the quiet lattice after, motes, soft light, bokeh overlay
panels.action: Ninety seconds to the gate. She has never once looked at him this hard.

dialogue.text: You were slow on the third one.
I was fine on the third one.
You were slow. It's not a criticism, it's a time.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not hearing a word of it, looking at a boy she sees every day

panels.bg: soft light, motes, flat tone, bokeh
panels.action: This is the part she has been unable to put down for four days.

dialogue.text: He does this every Thursday.
And on Monday somebody poured water down his sleeve.
And he said it was fine, and everyone laughed.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the worst part arriving

panels.bg: flat tone, hard closing edges, no bokeh
panels.action: And there is a part after that.

dialogue.text: Two weeks ago Amasaki made a joke about his pin.
I didn't say anything. I smiled. It was easier.
I have been the nice one at him for two years.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sheathing the sword, glancing over

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: mouth opening on it, four days of pressure behind it

panels.bg: the lattice, the gate beginning to open as a white band at the far end
panels.action: It nearly comes out here. That would have been easier for everybody.

dialogue.text: Null. There's something I have to—
Gate.
Right. Yeah. Gate.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette
chars.pose: a pace behind him, hand half-raised toward his back

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — two solid black figures against a flat white field, the gate as a hard vertical edge. No features. Her raised hand is the only asymmetry in the composition.
panels.action: Same two lines, thirteen months running.

dialogue.text: Same time Thursday.
Same time Thursday.
Four days. Say it tomorrow. Say it tomorrow or don't say it ever.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: enormous, arm round Kou's neck, dragging

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, being hauled, cloth bundle under one arm

panels.bg: the academy courtyard, Friday morning, students streaming past, the Tower behind, tone-washed
panels.action: Friday. Day four.

dialogue.text: You look worse than usual and that's a genuine achievement.
Stocktake ran late.
The STOREROOM again. At night. Voluntarily.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: chibi, hands on head, wailing

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, walking on without him

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. Gen has been staging this intervention for two years.

dialogue.text: Come to the arcade! Come to ONE thing! Ever!
I've got stocktake.
YOU'RE SEVENTEEN. NOTHING NEEDS COUNTING THAT BADLY.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, mild, walking, eyes down

panels.bg: courtyard, tone wash, blurred students
panels.action: Two years of a lie, told to the only person on the ground floor who wants him.

dialogue.text: Gen's asked me to about ninety things.
I've said yes to one. His birthday, first year.
He still brings it up. That's the part I don't like.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: clipboard, tired, addressing the room

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: already standing up

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: not looking up

panels.bg: classroom 2-B, morning, students at desks, tone wash
panels.action: Somebody has to do the equipment log. It is always the same somebody.

dialogue.text: Equipment log needs doing before fourth period.
Volunteers.
Hazama does it.
I'll do it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: head coming up very slowly, the smile absolutely still in place
chars.pose: seated four desks away, pen stopping

panels.bg: classroom, hard morning light, everything behind her going flat and out of focus
panels.action: A room she knows the location of, with a door.

dialogue.text: Equipment storeroom. Third floor. Off the training hall.
One door. No windows.
Oh, that's it. That's the one. That's where I do it.

panels.bg: the third-floor training hall — high ceiling, practice mats, twenty-odd students in kit doing warm-ups under an instructor, and at the far end a plain door marked EQUIPMENT, tone-washed
panels.action: Second period. Twenty-two people, one thin door.

dialogue.text: Twenty-two people in that hall.
Which is fine. Which is completely fine.
You have that face on. The forty-one-dives face.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: arms folded, blocking her by six inches of body language

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: gracious, immovable

panels.bg: the edge of the training hall, mats, students behind, tone wash
panels.action: Riko is the only person alive who tries.

dialogue.text: If you say it out loud, you can't unsay it.
I know.
And he can end you with one sentence to Nabari.
I know that too.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the public smile off, and something much more like KETTLE underneath it

panels.bg: the door marked EQUIPMENT, tone wash, hall noise implied
panels.action: Thirteen months of being the only honest thing in her week.

dialogue.text: Riko. He's the one person I've never had to be good in front of.
I'm not going to sit four desks away and pretend.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, hands up in total surrender

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, marching, aura of doom

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. Riko concedes the way she always concedes.

dialogue.text: Fine. Go. But I want it on record—
—that I said this was insane before you did it.
Noted and logged. Cover me.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, hand on the handle, and the nerve going out of her at the last second
chars.pose: stopped, palm flat on the door

panels.bg: the storeroom door from the hall side, the noise of twenty-two people behind her, hard flat tone
panels.action: Four days. Nine attempts. One door.

dialogue.text: I have addressed four hundred people from a podium.
I have cleared thirty-three layers of that tower.
Open the door, Ariake.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, halfway up a shelf with a clipboard, entirely absorbed
chars.pose: one foot on a crate, counting harnesses

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the doorway, the hall light behind her
chars.pose: one hand still on the handle

panels.bg: the equipment storeroom — steel shelving, coiled cable, numbered crates, one bare bulb, about a metre and a half of floor between the shelves
panels.action: The room is very small and there is no other way out of it.

dialogue.text: Hall's that way. Mats get signed out at the desk.
I don't want mats.
...Harnesses are all logged out until Monday, sorry.
I don't want a harness either.
Right.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: closing the door behind her, back against it, gloved hands flat

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: coming down off the crate, mild, clipboard still up

panels.bg: the storeroom, one bulb, and under the door a hard band of light with the shadows of feet crossing it
panels.action: Twenty-two people, four metres away, through a door.

dialogue.text: Ariake-san. If this is about the committee forms—
It isn't about the committee.
Then I genuinely don't know what it's about.
Could you put the clipboard down for a second.
...I'm mid-count.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: every rehearsed sentence gone, saying the only thing left

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb light, flat tone, her face close
panels.action: Nine drafts. None of them survive the room.

dialogue.text: Two loops.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — hand only, gone completely still on the clipboard
chars.pose: fingers stopped mid-page, sleeve pushed back off the bandaged forearm

panels.bg: the clipboard, the wrap, and on the outside of the wrist the doubled two-loop knot laid flat. Bare bulb, hard shadow. ART NOTE: identical knot silhouette to Ch.1 p14/p16/p18.
panels.action: Nothing else in the room moves either.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: level, quiet, and absolutely certain

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not turning round

panels.bg: the narrow storeroom, one bulb, the band of corridor light under the door
panels.action: She has to keep her voice down. That is the worst part.

dialogue.text: The knot. Outside of the wrist, laid flat. Won't come off in water.
I tied that. Layer thirty-two. Six days ago.
You bled on my hands, Null.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: nothing at all — the mild face, running, with something enormous behind it

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, flat tone
panels.action: He has been the blank pin for two years. It takes him one second to try it.

dialogue.text: I think you've got the wrong—
Don't.
Don't do the voice at me. I know the other one.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: escalating because he isn't giving her anything, which is what she always does
chars.pose: off the door now, one step in

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: standing there with a clipboard

panels.bg: the storeroom, shelving, bulb, close quarters
panels.action: He does not fill silences. She has thirteen months of practice at filling them for both of them.

dialogue.text: You said 'one. Older.' On a bridge. Thursday.
You count out loud. You always say 'gate' instead of 'time'.
You said good knot. You said GOOD KNOT, and I—

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hearing herself, mortified, and unable to stop

panels.bg: flat tone, bulb, close
panels.action: This is what she came in to say. It is not what she rehearsed.

dialogue.text: I've been trying to say this since Monday.
I wrote a note. It said 'I know what you did on Thursday.'
I ate it. I actually ate it. Please say something.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: setting the clipboard down on a crate, very carefully, buying four seconds

panels.bg: the crate, the clipboard, shelving, bulb light
panels.action: Four seconds. Then he stops trying.

dialogue.text: ...How long have you known.
Monday morning. Eight twenty-two.
Of course you know the minute.
Don't do that either. That's a Null thing.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: turning round properly, and it is a completely different face — the tower one, mild armour gone

panels.bg: the storeroom, one bulb, everything behind him dropping to flat tone
panels.action: First time on the ground floor. It lands like a stranger walking in.

dialogue.text: Yeah. It's me.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: she got what she came for and has no idea what to do with it

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, flat tone, the band of light under the door
panels.action: Four days of pressure, and the release is worse than the pressure.

dialogue.text: ...Right.
Right. Okay. Good.
You had a whole thing planned and it's gone, hasn't it.
Completely gone.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: leaning back against the shelving, arms folded, flat

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: opposite him, a metre and a half of floor

panels.bg: the storeroom, two people, no exit, bare bulb
panels.action: He says it first because he has been waiting two years to be able to.

dialogue.text: You're going to be really disappointed.
That's not—
You said you wouldn't be. On thirty-two.
You said that to Null.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: opening her mouth and nothing coming out of it

panels.bg: flat tone, bulb, close, everything else gone
panels.action: She has an answer. It is the true one and she cannot get it out in a storeroom on a Friday.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: nodding once, taking the silence as the answer, entirely without blame

panels.bg: the crate, the clipboard, shelving
panels.action: He does not hold it against her. That is somehow the worst available outcome.

dialogue.text: It's fine. Genuinely.
I've got the log to finish and you've got second period.
Don't do 'it's fine' at me. I've heard you do that.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: stopped, clipboard half up, actually caught

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: furious now, which is much easier than the other thing

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, the band of light under the door with feet crossing it
panels.action: She is much better at angry than she is at sincere, and both of them are about to find that out.

dialogue.text: You say it to Amasaki. You say it about the water bottle.
You have never once said it to me up there.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the flat mild face finally cracking, and what is under it is tired

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, flat tone
panels.action: Two years of the same two words, and somebody has finally noticed the difference.

dialogue.text: Because up there it's true.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: absolutely stopped by that

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: already regretting having said it, going back to the shelf

panels.bg: storeroom, shelving, bulb
panels.action: He puts it back in the box immediately, which is his entire personality.

dialogue.text: Forget that. That was — forget it.
No.
Ariake-san—
Oh, don't. Not 'Ariake-san'. Not from you.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: genuinely stuck, gesturing at nothing

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: arms folded, waiting

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, close quarters
panels.action: Here is the actual problem, and it takes them nine seconds to find it.

dialogue.text: Then what do I call you.
Kettle.
In a school building. In daylight.
...Right. No. That's worse.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, hands in hair, spiralling

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, flat line mouth, clipboard held like a shield

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. Two of the most competent people in the building, defeated by nouns.

dialogue.text: Thirteen months! We've had thirteen months of conversations!
All of them were about monsters.
THAT'S A CONVERSATION TOPIC.
It's a narrow one.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, sitting down on a crate, giving up on standing

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: leaning on the shelving opposite

panels.bg: the storeroom, two people on opposite sides of a metre and a half, bulb light
panels.action: Six hours ago they were fluent. It has taken forty minutes to lose an entire language.

dialogue.text: We were fine last night.
We were.
I could talk to you for four hours without stopping.
You did. Twice.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, looking at the floor, saying the practical thing because it is the only safe one

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, flat tone
panels.action: The other thing in the room, finally said out loud.

dialogue.text: You know I'm on a nullified pin.
Yes.
No magic reading means no dive clearance. At all.
One sentence to Nabari and I'm gone by Monday.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: flat, entirely unbothered, giving hers up immediately

panels.bg: the storeroom, shelving, bulb
panels.action: She does not hesitate for even a quarter of a second.

dialogue.text: Faculty banned me after my third clear.
Too valuable to risk. Forty-two dives since.
Forged gate logs. Riko does the forging.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: looking at her properly for the first time in the scene

panels.bg: flat tone, bulb, close
panels.action: She handed that over unprompted, in eleven seconds, in a room with a door.

dialogue.text: ...You didn't have to tell me that.
You'd have found out. You find everything out.
And now we're even, so stop looking at me like that.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — the blank rank pin on his collar, catching no light at all
chars.pose: close on the collar and the empty setting where a stone should be

panels.bg: the collar, the pin, flat tone, hard bulb light
panels.action: The only monologue this chapter gets on the subject.

dialogue.text: She could have me expelled before lunch.
I could do the same to her before the bell.
Neither of us is going to. I don't know why I'm sure.
I'm sure.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — two solid black figures against a flat pale field, the shelving reduced to three horizontal bars, the door a hard vertical band of light between them. No features.
panels.action: Two people holding each other's whole lives, in a cupboard, in second period.

dialogue.text: So that's that, then.
That's that.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: trying, visibly, to have a conversation like a person

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: trying equally hard, equally badly

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, the two of them, tone wash
panels.action: Attempt one at daylight conversation.

dialogue.text: So. You. What do you — outside. What do you do.
Stocktake.
That's the lie you tell Ōkubo.
...It's also true. I do the stocktake.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: grinding to a halt

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: grinding to a halt in parallel

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, silence rendered as flat empty tone
panels.action: Attempt two.

dialogue.text: Right. Yes. Good.
Mm.
This is horrific.
It's really quite bad.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, forehead on knees, wailing

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, patting the air near her shoulder without touching it

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. Neither of these people has any idea how to be the other one down here.

dialogue.text: I have BANTER. I'm famous for banter!
You're famous for gate discipline announcements.
UP THERE I'M FAMOUS FOR BANTER.
That's the problem, yeah.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, and something occurring to him

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: looking up

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, tone wash
panels.action: He reaches for the only vocabulary they both actually own.

dialogue.text: Okay. Different approach. You were slow on the third one.
I was FINE on the third one.
Half a second late off the left span.
Because SOMEBODY told me to hold the middle—

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: mid-argument, alight, entirely herself for the first time in the room
chars.pose: up off the crate, pointing at him

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: dry, arms folded, giving as good as he gets

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, both of them animated for the first time, tone wash
panels.action: There it is. It took forty minutes and it needed a tactical dispute to start it.

dialogue.text: —hold the middle, on a bridge, with no cover, alone!
You had cover. I was the cover.
YOU ARE NOT COVER. YOU ARE A MAN WITH A STICK.
And yet.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: enormous, cheerful, halfway through the door before he processes anything

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: caught mid-argument

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: caught mid-point, finger still out

panels.bg: the storeroom door flung open, training hall light and noise flooding in, twenty-two people behind him
panels.action: The door was never locked. Nobody thought to lock the door.

dialogue.text: HAZAMA. Nabari wants the log by fourth, he's doing his face—
—oh. Oh! Ariake-san?!

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the public smile arriving in about a tenth of a second, immaculate, warm, unrecognisable

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: instantly disarmed

panels.bg: the storeroom doorway, hall light, tone wash
panels.action: One tenth of a second. It is genuinely frightening to watch.

dialogue.text: Ōkubo-kun, isn't it? Sorry — I was asking about the equipment log.
The committee needs the harness numbers by Monday.
Oh! Right! That's — yeah, that sounds like a committee thing.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face back on, exactly as fast as hers

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: looking between them, sensing nothing at all

panels.bg: storeroom, hall light, students visible behind
panels.action: He does it just as fast. Neither of them enjoys watching the other do it.

dialogue.text: Am I interrupting something?
Harness numbers.
Right! Boring! Great! Log! Fourth period!

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: chibi, saluting, backing out

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, waving him off

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, halo, beatific public smile

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch on the exit.

dialogue.text: She TALKED to me. Ariake-san TALKED to me!
Log. Fourth period.
SHE KNEW MY NAME, HAZAMA.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, the smile gone the instant the door shuts, looking at the closed door

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, watching her have done that

panels.bg: the storeroom, door shut again, bulb, the hall noise muffled
panels.action: They have just watched each other lie effortlessly, from eighteen inches away, for the first time.

dialogue.text: You did that instantly.
So did you.
...Yeah.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: quiet, unguarded, the first honest face she has made in daylight in this series
chars.pose: leaning back against the shut door

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: listening

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, the muffled hall beyond, soft tone
panels.action: This is the closest either of them has been to the truth on the ground floor.

dialogue.text: Nobody's ever seen me do that and known what it was.
Riko has.
Riko's seen it. She doesn't know what it costs.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, and answering it straight for once

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, flat tone
panels.action: He does not comfort her. He states a fact, which from him is the same thing.

dialogue.text: I know what it costs.
I know you do. That's the entire problem.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: pushing off the door, brisk, packing it away
chars.pose: straightening her cuffs, gloves back on properly

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: watching the armour go back on

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, the door handle in frame
panels.action: Second period is nine minutes from ending.

dialogue.text: Right. I have committee at lunch and a speech at four.
And I've got the log.
And tonight neither of us has anything, because it's Friday.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: understanding exactly what that sentence was, and having no procedure for it

panels.bg: flat tone, bulb, close
panels.action: That was not an observation about the calendar.

dialogue.text: That wasn't about the calendar.
Thirteen months. I know exactly what she does with her voice.
That wasn't about the calendar.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hand on the door handle, not turning round, saying it to the wood

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: behind her

panels.bg: the storeroom door from inside, the band of light around it, bulb behind them
panels.action: She does not ask. She states a location, a time and a quantity, because that is the only grammar she owns.

dialogue.text: West gate. The chicken place by the crossing.
Half seven. Nine pieces.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the flat face, and behind it something with no name on it

panels.bg: storeroom, bulb, flat tone, her back out of focus in the foreground
panels.action: Thirteen months of her describing that place to him at one in the morning.

dialogue.text: She's talked about that place forty times.
Every single dive. Always nine pieces.
She has never once asked me to come.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: saying the true thing badly, because it is the only defence he has left

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: half-turned at the door

panels.bg: the storeroom, bulb, door
panels.action: He tells her the truth and she hears something else entirely.

dialogue.text: I don't really eat.
I've watched you eat. You eat like homework.
That's — yes. That's accurate.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, both fists up, absolutely triumphant

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, defeated

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. She has won and she knows she has won.

dialogue.text: Then come and eat like homework AT me. Half seven.
That's not really how it—
NINE. PIECES.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, in the open doorway, hall light behind her, waiting for an actual answer

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, mild

panels.bg: the storeroom door open, training hall light and noise, twenty-two people beyond
panels.action: One word. It is the first thing he has ever agreed to on the ground floor.

dialogue.text: ...Okay.
Okay.
Don't be late. I'll order without you.
You'd order anyway.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: alone, clipboard up, going back to counting harnesses, face doing absolutely nothing

panels.bg: the storeroom, door shut, one bulb, shelving, hard flat tone at the frame edges
panels.action: Final panel. He has not tasted anything since he was fourteen.

dialogue.text: Taste went at layer four.
Nine pieces of something I won't be able to tell from paper.
I said yes anyway.
Half seven.
